questions.prompt: What is implied about the quarrel between the neighbouring farms?

options.text: Ruddiforth’s neighbour answered the claim without bringing the railway company’s plan into the letters.
The quarrel began because the thorn on the bank had been left untended.
The surveyor came to the bank after the attorneys had begun to write.
The ground Ruddiforth was claiming was the same ground the surveyor had pegged out.
